page.overview:
What is Spring Colorway Animatronics?

The spring colorway animatronics are animatronic variant sets that appear exclusively as Five Nights at Freddy's merchandise.

They appear similar to the blacklight animatronics except with lighter "spring" colors. They were only sold as plushies in both normal and jumbo size.

Spring Colorway Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart.

Spring Colorway Foxy is Foxy's counterpart.
